faqs.question: What does BCA stand for?
faqs.answer: BCA stands for Bachelor of Computer Applications.

faqs.question: What is NGC AI?
faqs.answer: NGC AI is an AI-powered college assistant designed to help students and faculty find useful academic and college-related information.

faqs.question: Which BCA course does the college offer?
faqs.answer: The available college information lists Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) as an undergraduate course under the Computer Applications department.

faqs.question: What department offers BCA?
faqs.answer: The available college information lists the Computer Applications department for BCA.

faqs.question: What is the official name of the college?
faqs.answer: The official name of the college is Nagarjuna Government College (Autonomous).

faqs.question: Where is Nagarjuna Government College located?
faqs.answer: Nagarjuna Government College is located in Nalgonda, Telangana, India.

faqs.question: What is the college code for Nagarjuna Government College?
faqs.answer: The college code for Nagarjuna Government College is 4028.

faqs.question: Who is the principal of Nagarjuna Government College?
faqs.answer: The principal of Nagarjuna Government College is Prof. S. Upender, M.Sc., Ph.D.

faqs.question: What is the official website of Nagarjuna Government College?
faqs.answer: The official website of Nagarjuna Government College is https://ngcollegenalgonda.ac.in/

faqs.question: What are the contact details for Nagarjuna Government College?
faqs.answer: You can contact Nagarjuna Government College via email at nalgonda.jkc@gmail.com or by phone at 9848696776.

faqs.question: What B.Com programmes are available?
faqs.answer: The NGC Admissions Brochure 2026-27 lists B.Com (Computer Applications), B.Com (Business Analytics), and B.Com (Finance).
